title: The same recall, Britain and abroad
what: Every UK recall matched by manufacturer reference to an American campaign, a Canadian recall or a European Safety Gate alert, with both dates and the gap in days. One row per UK recall with at least one match.
source: DVSA RecallsFile.csv joined to NHTSA, Transport Canada and Safety Gate on the maker's own reference
